ValidationRule.description: Payment Terms are fixed once the proposal is processed: cannot be changed when the previous stage is Proposal/Quote, Negotiation, Closed Won or Closed Lost. Setting terms in the same save that moves the deal to Proposal/Quote is still allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Taman_Safari", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Payment_Terms__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Proposal/Quote"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment Terms can no longer be changed because the proposal has already been processed (Proposal/Quote or later). Set the terms before moving to Proposal/Quote.
